technical_requirements: Workloads: low-latency chat (p95 < 150ms), high-volume embeddings for search (100k embeddings/day)
Throughput target: sustained 200 reqs/s for chat at 1-2k token responses; spikes to 600 reqs/s expected
Model preferences: open models first (redwood-verified + Llama-2-variants), automatic fallback to smaller distilled variant
Routing: region-aware routing (US primary), auto-fallback to lower-cost model when capacity constrained
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency charts, request tracing
Security: SSO (SAML), KMS-managed keys, audit logs retained 12 months, US data residency requirement
pricing_negotiation: LithoScale proposal: prefer 1.0M committed tokens/month with 2x burst credits for seasonal spikes
Redwood proposed: 1.5M token/month commit with 3x burst allowance and ramp schedule (25% month1, 50% month2, 100% month3)
Open items: cap on monthly overage (procurement wants max 20% of commit), overage unit price (procurement asks for 1.2x committed unit price), and billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly true-up)
